clips.title: The story
paras: Threat from Below is a Horde quest centered on investigating a violent ambush along the eastern shores of Durotar. After scout Heglan Shadeeye is ambushed at her post in a fierce skirmish, adventurers must inspect the devastated area for clues regarding the attackers. Uncovering physical evidence reveals an encroaching threat that directly endangers Razor Hill's defensive lines.

A violent skirmish along the Durotar coast leaves behind shattered earth and immediate cause for alarm among the Horde's defenders. Heglan Shadeeye, a Shattered Hand scout keeping watch from her post, was ambushed by an unseen adversary. The skirmish site clearly demonstrates that Heglan fought back fiercely and injured her attackers. With hostile forces moving unchecked along the eastern shoreline, Horde adventurers are called upon to survey the devastated campsite, comb the surrounding ground for clues, and determine what manner of enemy struck the scout.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.
Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.
We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
